translation:
Guidelines on Area Recognition for Common Curriculum Courses (including the 'World of Learning' [학문의 세계] Area)

Posted: 6 August 2026

Following the reform of the general education curriculum [교양교육과정] in the 2025 academic year, the criteria for recognising Common Curriculum [공통교육과정] courses towards curriculum areas are as follows.

1. Whether a course is recognised towards an area is determined by the Common Curriculum completion regulations [이수규정] of the student's year of admission.

2. Where a student has completed a course that was newly established after the student's year of admission:
   a. If the corresponding area exists in the completion regulations of the student's year of admission, the course is recognised as credits completed in that area.
   b. If the corresponding area does not exist in the completion regulations of the student's year of admission, the course is not counted towards the area requirements and is recognised only as credits towards the overall Common Curriculum (general education [교양]) credit total.
   ※ Where the new course has been designated as an equivalent or substitute course [동일·대체 교과목], taking the new course is recognised as credits in the pre-reform area of the existing course for which it is designated as equivalent or substitute.
